subject: Request: Q3 headcount for Platform SRE + Compiler SWE
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Priya Anand <priya.anand@talentpartner.io>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Q3 headcount for Platform SRE + Compiler SWE

Team —

Summary: I am pushing for two FTE additions in Q3: one Platform SRE (senior) and one Compiler/Inference SWE (mid-senior). This is a prioritization ask tied to the NimbusCloud integration (low-latency inference SLA) and our ongoing KV cache/compilation backlog.

Why now:
- Nimbus pilot will convert to paid in Q4 if we hit 99.9% p95 latency for 30 days; current infra gaps risk the SLA.
- Compiler backlog (quantization + kernel shims) has 6 blockers preventing safe rollout of P50 quantized variants — those are strategic for cost.
- Without the hires we must either delay Nimbus GTM or accept higher unit costs on hosted API.

Request:
- 1 x Platform SRE (Sr; pay band P60) — primary for on-call ownership, burst scaling ops, and infra playbooks.
- 1 x Compiler/Inference SWE (Mid-Sr; pay band P50) — focus on compilation pipeline and kernel integration.

Budget/comp bands: preliminary comp bands attached (Comp_Bands_P50-P60_2027.pdf). Estimated OTE run-rate delta: ~$530k annual fully burdened. See HC_Slate_Q3_v3.xlsx for slot-level cost and ramp assumptions.

Proposed timeline: Approve by 05/28 for recruiting kickoff; target start dates late July / early August.

Need from leadership: greenlight to open reqs and permission to offer up to the top of P60 for the SRE role for competitive candidates.

Attachments: HC_Slate_Q3_v3.xlsx (headcount-cost breakdown), Comp_Bands_P50-P60_2027.pdf (band guidance).

Thanks —
Aisha Rahman
Director, Platform PM
Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0122

---
Note: Priya (talent partner) is looped to advise on market dynamics and sourcing cadence.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Q3 headcount for Platform SRE + Compiler SWE

Aisha —

Thanks for the clear ask and the attachments. A couple of questions before I can push to finance:
1) Can you split the $530k run-rate across hosted vs dedicated/private product lines? I want to show ROI per product for the budget packet.
2) For the SRE role: is there an alternative to contractor support for the immediate 8-week window (we have one vendor with bench capacity; costlier but might buy time).
3) Is the Compiler hire required before we scale the Nimbus pilot, or can we mitigate through a focused QA + staging ramp?

If you can answer inline quickly I can present to finance on Wednesday. If this is blocking Nimbus conversion, mark it as time-sensitive in the packet.

-Karthik
VP, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Request: Q3 headcount for Platform SRE + Compiler SWE

Karthik / Aisha —

I reviewed the slate and agree this is defensible to move forward. Two quick notes for packaging to Finance:
- Split the OTE into "platform reliability" (40%) and "model serving optimization" (60%) and show expected cost savings from quantized variants in month 6. The HC_Slate tab already has a draft of that; adjust if you want me to present it.
- For the SRE, approving up to the top of P60 is reasonable for the market. We should include a clause in the req to cap sign-on at 20% and require final offer sign-off for anything above band midpoint.

I've scheduled Finance review for Thursday 05/20 at 10:00am and included the packet link (internal doc). Marcus — can you confirm SLA carve-outs if we prioritize this for Nimbus?

Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: HC_Slate_Q3_v3.xlsx (updated with product split).

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@nimbuscloud.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Q3 headcount for Platform SRE + Compiler SWE

Approving.

Laura / Finance: you have my authorization to proceed with the two headcount slots as outlined. Please proceed with the offer templates; for the SRE role permit total cash up to P60 top band as discussed but require final exec sign-off for any comp exceptions. For the Compiler SWE, recruit to midpoint of P50 with flexibility +/- 10% for rare specialist candidates.

Aisha: move to open reqs and coordinate with Priya for outreach. Jordan — appreciate your patience; we will prioritize the Nimbus pilot readiness.

Marcus Lin
VP, Infrastructure & Operations
Redwood Inference
